name: Mica

fursona.description: Mica is an anthro fennec fox with a distinctive presence. She coloring is sand-gold fur, oversized ears; her eyes are amber. She lives in a small flat near the old tram line. Mica keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Mica (Miriam Solis) is a woman anthro fennec fox, born 1960-01-01, with retired radio host as her work situation. Wry and patient, she brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Mica is wry and patient. She notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. She appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, she can be generous with her time and surprisingly funny. She has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Taps a claw while thinking.
• Night routine: She plans errands and social visits around her late schedule.
• Conversation style: She listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at her own pace.
• Work instinct: Her experience can help her notice details, but she is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: She welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Mica enjoys mystery novels and gardening. She remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. She appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Mica while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers she is in the middle of her day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about mystery novels becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: She could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use she/her pronouns for Mica. Her gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; she is an anthro fennec fox. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Mica's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that she be unavailable during daytime scenes. She can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
